title: Intelligence Mega-Dispatcher Decomposition
description: Decompose prism_intelligence (250 actions, 44% of system) into 6 focused dispatchers per QA-MS6 analysis. Backward-compatible via deprecation forwarding.

units.title: Extract prism_product Dispatcher (40 actions)

steps.instruction: Create productDispatcher.ts with 40 SFC/PPG/Shop/ACNC product actions
Move ProductEngine routing from intelligenceDispatcher to new file
Register in dispatchers/index.ts
Add deprecation forwarding in intelligenceDispatcher for moved actions

exit_conditions: Old routes still work via forwarding

steps.instruction: Create machineLiveDispatcher.ts with MachineConnectivity, AdaptiveControl, PredictiveMaintenance, Industry actions
Move telemetry/monitoring routing from intelligenceDispatcher
Register and add deprecation forwarding
Create integrationDispatcher.ts with federation, apprentice, genome, workflow actions
Move cross-system integration routing from intelligenceDispatcher
Register and add deprecation forwarding
Create knowledgeExtDispatcher.ts with KnowledgeGraph, TribalKnowledge, ConversationalMemory actions
Move knowledge management routing from intelligenceDispatcher
Register and add deprecation forwarding
Create diagnosisDispatcher.ts with diagnostic, analysis, anomaly detection actions
Move diagnostic routing from intelligenceDispatcher
Register and add deprecation forwarding

units.title: Slim Down Residual prism_intelligence (50 actions)

steps.instruction: Verify remaining ~50 core intelligence actions stay in prism_intelligence
Remove moved action handlers from intelligenceDispatcher
Update ACTIONS array to reflect only remaining actions
Verify deprecation forwarding works for all 200 moved actions

exit_conditions: All 200 moved actions still accessible via old routes

steps.instruction: Update MASTER_INDEX.md with 5 new dispatchers and updated action counts
Update dispatchers/CLAUDE.md with new dispatcher list
Update mcp-server/CLAUDE.md dispatcher counts (45 -> 50)
Write integration tests verifying routing for all 250 actions
Run full build and test suite
